from object_detector import Object_Detector_Tool

# Sample image path and object labels
sample_image_path = "/nfs/data8/liao/wxie/SAT/SAT_images_train/1815_0.png"
label_list = ["baseball", "basket"]

# Set confidence threshold and model size
confidence_threshold = 0.35
model_size = "tiny"

# Execute object detection
detected_objects = Object_Detector_Tool.execute(image=sample_image_path, labels=label_list, confidence_threshold=confidence_threshold, model_size=model_size, save_object=True)

# Count the number of detected objects
object_number = len(detected_objects)

final_result = { 
    "image_counts": { label: detected_objects[label].count() for label in detected_objects },
    "object_number": object_number
}

print("Final Results:", final_result)
